alt: Footprints line the desert. WV and Serenity emerge from the bunker. Camera pans out, revealing the desert sand to be filling a massive crater. The bunker itself blasts out of the ground. It's a massive cylinder with the Sburb logo on it, with rockets on the bottom. It soars through the air with WV and Serenity riding on top. The camera pans out and heads to a westward continent. YEARS IN THE PAST.. BUT NOT MANY... John's neighborhood is struck by a meteor, leaving nothing but a massive crater in its place. Years fly by, and the crater fills with sand. A giant tree begins to sprout and bloom in the center of the crater. An orb with the Sburb logo on it sprouts from one of the branches and falls to the sand. The peregrine mendicant is passing by with the cart of mailboxes, when a flash of light appears in the sky... it's the wayward vagabond riding the flying bunker! The scene changes again to AN OCEAN WESTWARD, AND YEARS IN THE PAST. A volcano is flowing. Flashes of fossils suggest this is during the dinosaur age. The camera zooms out to outer space to show a green spirograph portal appearing and dispensing a space rock. This space rock descends, and a meteor strikes just outside the volcano, creating another crater. The crater slowly fills with lava and dries up over time. A mysterious green forest grows in the center of the crater, with several green towers constructed throughout. A massive green temple is constructed at the center, taller than the other towers. A giant frog statue sits at the top, and an extremely steep staircase leads to an entrance at the very top of the temple. Over the years, the area begins to fill with water. Eventually, the area becomes a small archipelago in the middle of the ocean, with ocean water submerging most of the now ancient towers. The frog tower still reaches high above the water. Pteradactyls roam the skies above. The scene changes again. Rose frustratedly pounds the generator as the fire destroys the forest around her. Her mother watches stoicly from a window and presses a button, revealing ladder rungs that descend down from underneath Jaspers' tomb. In the mysterious purple city, John's DAD is handcuffed and being walked down a path by imps. He opens the trick handcuffs, and, with a birthday cake and a can of shaving cream, takes his revenge on the imps. Dave and his bro stand on the rooftop, staring at the sun. The flying bunker descends towards a frog temple in the middle of the desert with a massive crater next to it. It makes a gentle landing, and the wayward vagabond gazes up at the towering temple before them.
